proposal.description: The cycle-boundary strobe fires on both edges of pwm_sync, so the windows take two samples per switching cycle (valley and peak) instead of one at the valley.
proposal.reason: In S_SS and S_RUN, every switching cycle now moves each window and its count by two samples. A sustained overcurrent raises fault_count_*_out twice as fast, and window_trip / window_trip_SS assert after about half as many cycles.

proposal.description: The blanking history shifts toward bit 0 with cp_sync entering at the MSB, so the tapped bit cp_delay[BLANK_CLKS-1] holds cp_sync from one clock ago instead of from BLANK_CLKS clocks ago.
proposal.reason: Suppose cp_sync changes within the BLANK_CLKS clocks before pwm_rise, for example during the high-side turn-on slew. The sample stored in the window and added to fault_count_run_out / fault_count_ss_out then takes the new value, not the earlier one, and this can raise or block window_trip.

proposal.description: The soft-start window keeps advancing during S_RUN together with the run window, instead of being frozen at its S_SS value for telemetry.
proposal.reason: After S_SS -> S_RUN, fault_count_ss_out changes with every S_RUN sample (for example it drains to 0 when there is no overcurrent) instead of holding the count that soft start ended with.

proposal.description: The idle clear resets the run window but leaves the soft-start window and count holding the history from before the hiccup.
proposal.reason: After window_trip_SS sends the FSM to S_HICCUP, fault_count_ss_out stays at or above trip_ss. On the retry into S_SS, window_trip_SS asserts at once, so the part hiccups again without any new overcurrent.

proposal.description: The idle clear resets the soft-start window but leaves the run window and count holding the history from before the hiccup.
proposal.reason: After window_trip ends a run, fault_count_run_out keeps its tripped value through S_HICCUP and the next S_SS. On re-entry to S_RUN, window_trip asserts immediately even with no overcurrent.

after: always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
else begin window_trip <= run_active && (pmic_types_pkg::TRIP_W'(fault_count_run) >= trip_run); end
proposal.description: window_trip is registered, so it follows the run count and run_active one clock late.
proposal.reason: In S_RUN, window_trip rises one clock after fault_count_run_out reaches trip_run. After S_RUN is left, it stays high for one more clock even though run_active is low.

proposal.description: The S_RUN trip compares the run count for equality with trip_run instead of 'at or above' it.
proposal.reason: If TRIP_RUN is lowered during S_RUN to below the current fault_count_run_out, window_trip does not assert even though the count exceeds the threshold. It asserts only if the count later falls back to exactly trip_run.

proposal.description: The soft-start telemetry output is gated by ss_active like window_trip_SS, so it reads 0 outside S_SS instead of reporting the held count.
proposal.reason: After a soft start with some faulted cycles, fault_count_ss_out reads 0 throughout S_RUN instead of the frozen non-zero count.
